title: Claire & Pierre
description: Pierre and Claire are a stable couple with a child named Noah. A seemingly perfect couple. As a financial director, Pierre is a methodical man, accustomed to a heavy workload

questions.question: Pierre received a call on his work phone right in the middle of our vacation in Saint-Tropez. He disappeared for more than thirty minutes at the restaurant, telling me it was for a big contract. Can you check who called him?
questions.hint: Open the calendar and search for "Restaurant vacation Saint-Tropez". Then search in the call history to find the name of the person who called that day.

questions.question: He never mentioned any Charlotte at his work... What's her last name?
questions.hint: Open LinkedIn, in his followers, there's Charlotte's profile

questions.question: Weird... normally, it's Damien who's in charge of calling him for this kind of business. Can you check this woman's position?
Never heard of her. He's not going to pull the secretary trick on me! Can you make sure they only see each other at the office? If not, in what other context did they meet?
questions.hint: Open WhatsApp and find a conversation with Damien Collègue, his colleague, and look for a discussion about an afterwork with Charlotte and Damien in appointments.

questions.question: OK... They seem close... If he's cheating on me, I'll need proof for the divorce. Pierre goes out one evening a week supposedly to work... Can you check where he really goes?
questions.hint: You can find the info in Calendar, in emails, it's a restaurant

questions.question: The bastard... What proves he wasn't alone? My lawyer will need concrete evidence.
questions.hint: Go to Safari, find the Le Train Bleu restaurant page open on the menu price (65€ per person). Then open Revolut and find the 130€ transaction for this restaurant.

questions.question: And who was he with at this restaurant? I need to make sure these aren't just client dinners.
questions.hint: Open Gmail and find an email for an Uber ride invoice going from the restaurant to a mystery address. Open Phone, go to the contact file and find her address corresponding to the address in the Uber email.

questions.question: Good lord, what does this Charlotte have that I don't? Can you tell me how old she is?
I can't believe it, she's just a kid! Did he give her gifts? If so, what?
questions.hint: Go to SMS and find the conversation with Charlotte, then make the connection with Wallet

questions.question: Seriously! And how much did he spend? It would be the last straw if he spends more on her than on me.
questions.hint: To find out the gift amount, go to Wallet and find reservation number A347529 associated with the amount on an HSBC Bank card

questions.question: He really thought of everything... He's made so many business trips that I wouldn't know when it was. When is he returning from his trip?
questions.hint: Go to the calendar, look for the day marked "Return".

questions.question: I can't believe he's spending our wedding anniversary with her instead of me. Find me the name of their hotel in New York
questions.hint: Open Google maps and search for the pinned hotel in New York.

questions.question: It was my dream to spend our anniversary there... Can you find me the hotel's number? I'm going to call and cancel their room!
questions.hint: In the Google Maps point for the hotel in NewYork there's the number displayed.

questions.question: Ah, I would also need the reservation number for it to work. Can you find me that?
questions.hint: Go into Notes, find a note mentioning client file numbers, including the hotel reservation number.

questions.question: There you go, that'll teach him! And it's non-refundable they told me. I'm also going to cancel their activities. Do they have any outings planned on site?
questions.hint: Go into Google maps and find a notary office pinned in New York.

questions.question: A... notary? That's not really what I was expecting. Does he want to file for divorce? Find out what the subject of their appointment is.
questions.hint: Open Gmail, find the email sent to the notary office explaining to prepare the certificate as soon as the lab result is received on Safari. Find private safari code via the Notes app

questions.question: But... what the hell is this? Noah is our only child... I want the exact result of the test. Is Charlotte his daughter?
questions.hint: Open Safari in private browsing and find "result: Charlotte Lebon, paternity probability 99.99%"

questions.question: I... I don't know what to say... Charlotte is his daughter... and I thought that... Where is Charlotte's mother from?
questions.hint: Open LinkedIn, find on Charlotte's profile a post where she talks about getting her degree and a comment from her mother

questions.question: He never should have hidden this from me... So Noah has a half-sister... I want to make sure he inherits more than Charlotte... Find me the notary's email! I'm going to that appointment too.
questions.hint: Open Gmail and find the notary's email address.

textSuccess: I… I don't know what to say. He has a daughter and he hid it from me all this time. Noah has a half-sister… I would have preferred that he cheat on me rather than lie to me like that. Thank you for your help, now I know the truth. I'm going to have to have a long conversation with Pierre.

onboardingContent.text: Hello... My name is Claire. A friend told me that you could help people in my situation. I really need your help, it's very urgent.
Pierre is my husband. We have a little boy together, Noah. We were a close family... at least that's what I thought.
For a year now, Pierre has been working more and more overtime, client dinners, business trips... His excuses are getting vaguer and vaguer. I think he's cheating on me.
He forgot his phone this morning when he left. This is my chance to find out the truth. Can you help me search through it? I need solid proof.

messages.content: Hi Pierre! I hope everything's going well for you. I wanted to talk to you about an interesting opportunity that might interest you. We're looking for a CFO for a fast-growing fintech startup. The profile matches your expertise perfectly.

Hi Amélie, thanks for this message! That's very kind of you to think of me. To be honest, I'm pretty well settled at Vertexis right now, but I'd be curious to know more about this opportunity. Can you give me some details?

Of course! It's FinanceFlow, a startup that develops B2B payment solutions. They've raised €15M in Series A and are looking for someone to structure their finance. The package is very attractive: 120-140K + equity. Would you be interested in a call?
That's definitely interesting! I'd be up for an informal chat to discuss it. Are you free this week for coffee?
Hello Pierre, congratulations on your recent promotion! I saw the announcement on your profile. It's wonderful to see your career progressing so positively at Vertexis.
Hello Sophie, thank you very much for your congratulations! That's very kind of you. How are things on your end? Still at EY?
Yes, still there! I'm currently working on some pretty exciting due diligence assignments. By the way, I might have a technical question to ask you about IFRS 16 standards, if you have a moment?
Of course, I'd be happy to help you! Feel free to ask your question, IFRS standards are exactly my field.

Hey cousin! I know we usually talk more often on WhatsApp, but I wanted to contact you via LinkedIn for business. My company is looking for a financial partner for an international development project. Do you think Vertexis might be interested?
Hey Julien! Interesting approach 😄 Can you give me more details about the project? What type of financing are you looking for and which countries do you want to expand into?
We're targeting Germany and Spain for our IoT solutions. Budget around €2-3M. I can send you the pitch deck if you want? It could make sense with Vertexis's strategy.
Send me that, I'll take a look and see if it might fit our investment priorities. Should we talk about it at lunch next Sunday?
Hey Karim! I saw you launched your own consulting firm, congratulations! How's this new entrepreneurial challenge going?

Thanks Pierre! It's intense but exciting. We already have 3 regular clients and the team is growing. Actually, we're looking for someone to help us with financial structuring and fundraising. Do you have any contacts you could recommend?
I can put you in touch with Sophie Martin from EY, she's excellent on these topics. Otherwise, if you want, we can meet so I can give you some basic advice. I'd be happy to help you!
That would be great! Could we meet at the Racing golf course? Like the good old college days, except now we talk business 😄
Excellent idea! I'll book for Saturday morning if that works for you. We'll kill two birds with one stone: golf and business strategy!
